lcc_original: 永恆主上帝將那人安置在伊甸園裏，去耕種，去看守。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יהוה/YHWH)
神→上帝 (LCC consistently uses 上帝 for אֱלֹהִים; UNV uses 神)
{<WAH0853>} kept with braces — LCC has no explicit word for the direct-object marker אֶת
使他修理→去耕種: LCC rephrases the ל+infinitive construct; WAH09001 (ל prefix) attached to 去 as the infinitive marker; WH05647+WTH8800 attached to 耕種
在…園裏: LCC adds 裏 for locative; SN tags applied to 伊甸 and 園 as in UNV, 裏 left unannotated
